question: 2026 yılbaşından bugüne yayınevi bazında net ciro ve satılan adet
referenceSql:
SELECT P.SPECODE AS ref_publisher,
SUM(CASE WHEN L.TRCODE IN (7,8) THEN L.LINENET ELSE -L.LINENET END) AS ref_net,
SUM(CASE WHEN L.TRCODE IN (7,8) THEN L.AMOUNT END) AS ref_units
FROM dbo.LG_411_01_STLINE L JOIN dbo.LG_411_ITEMS P ON L.STOCKREF=P.LOGICALREF
WHERE L.CANCELLED=0 AND L.LINETYPE=0 AND L.TRCODE IN (2,3,7,8)
AND L.DATE_ >= '2026-01-01' AND L.DATE_ < '2026-09-10' GROUP BY P.SPECODE
sql:
SELECT ITEMS.[SPECODE] AS yayinev, SUM(CASE WHEN (STLINE.[LINETYPE] = 0) AND (STLINE.[TRCODE] IN (2, 3, 7, 8)) THEN CASE WHEN STLINE.[TRCODE] IN (7, 8) THEN STLINE.[LINENET] ELSE -STLINE.[LINENET] END END) AS net_ciro, SUM(CASE WHEN (STLINE.[LINETYPE] = 0) AND (STLINE.[TRCODE] IN (7, 8)) THEN STLINE.[AMOUNT] END) AS satilan_adet
FROM (SELECT '211' AS [__nb_firm], [AMOUNT], [CANCELLED], [DATE_], [LINENET], [LINETYPE], [STOCKREF], [TRCODE] FROM [dbo].[LG_211_01_STLINE] UNION ALL SELECT '411' AS [__nb_firm], [AMOUNT], [CANCELLED], [DATE_], [LINENET], [LINETYPE], [STOCKREF], [TRCODE] FROM [dbo].[LG_411_01_STLINE]) AS STLINE
JOIN (SELECT '211' AS [__nb_firm], [LOGICALREF], [SPECODE] FROM [dbo].[LG_211_ITEMS] UNION ALL SELECT '411' AS [__nb_firm], [LOGICALREF], [SPECODE] FROM [dbo].[LG_411_ITEMS]) AS ITEMS ON STLINE.[STOCKREF] = ITEMS.[LOGICALREF] AND STLINE.[__nb_firm] = ITEMS.[__nb_firm]
WHERE STLINE.[CANCELLED] = 0
  AND STLINE.[CANCELLED] = 0
  AND (((STLINE.[LINETYPE] = 0) AND (STLINE.[TRCODE] IN (2, 3, 7, 8))) OR ((STLINE.[LINETYPE] = 0) AND (STLINE.[TRCODE] IN (7, 8))))
  AND STLINE.[DATE_] >= '2026-01-01' AND STLINE.[DATE_] < '2026-09-10'
GROUP BY ITEMS.[SPECODE]
ORDER BY net_ciro DESC

'net ciro' → SUM(CASE WHEN STLINE.TRCODE IN (7, 8) THEN STLINE.LINENET ELSE -STLINE.LINENET END) [CERTIFIED, 5 doğrulanmış sorgu, doküman 1, insan 0]
'satilan adet' → SUM(STLINE.AMOUNT) [CERTIFIED, 1 doğrulanmış sorgu, doküman 1, insan 0]

STLINE: dönemle kesişen tablolar okundu (LG_211_01_STLINE, LG_411_01_STLINE)
ITEMS: dönemle kesişen tablolar okundu (LG_211_ITEMS, LG_411_ITEMS)
join dönem içinde kapalı: STLINE ↔ ITEMS, her dönem kendi kaydıyla
